Introduction

MYTEEN was a South Korean boy group under The Music Works that consisted of seven members: Taevin, Chunjin, Eunsu, Xiheon, Junseop, Yuvin, and Hanseul.

After promoting for two years, the group officially disbanded on August 21, 2019.
